subject.title: fix: keep yielded parent runs deferred until subagents settle

question: Should yielded cron parents become a first-class public `deferred` status across persistence, Gateway protocol, CLI, hooks, Plugin SDK, and UI, with non-zero `cron run --wait` exit behavior?
rationale: The implementation is internally coherent, but adding a durable status and Plugin SDK lifecycle classifier establishes compatibility-sensitive semantics that code review and runtime proof cannot authorize on their own.

options.title: Approve the deferred contract
options.body: Accept `deferred` as the canonical public yielded-parent handoff state, contingent on exact-head upgrade and delivery proof.

options.title: Keep deferral internal
options.body: Preserve the existing public status union and represent yielded waiting through internal task/session state, requiring a narrower redesign of the branch.

options.title: Split the change
options.body: Land core parent reconciliation separately and review the public status, SDK, UI, and Discord behavior as follow-up changes.

recommendation.title: Approve the deferred contract
recommendation.body: Accept `deferred` as the canonical public yielded-parent handoff state, contingent on exact-head upgrade and delivery proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision primarily governs agents, subagents, cron lifecycle, and the public status contract documented as this person's ownership area.
